description: This Java class defines a Fragment called LogFragment that displays a log view within a scrollable interface, used for outputting log data received through the LogNode interface. It manages UI components such as LogView and ScrollView, and handles text change events to keep the view scrolled to the bottom.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that contains a LogView inside a ScrollView, used for displaying log messages and automatically scrolling to the latest entry.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView, setting layout parameters, styles, and padding.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the view hierarchy, sets up a TextWatcher to auto-scroll on new log entries.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance used within the fragment.
